text: The Patriots are heading to Soldier Field this Thursday night for a primetime showdown with the Bears, but they'll be doing so with some notable absences in their receiver room—Romeo Doubs is headed to injured reserve after suffering a shoulder injury on a 42-yard touchdown catch in last Sunday's 26-19 win over the Jets, while A.J. Brown's return from a four-week absence with a right high ankle sprain was far from seamless, as he dropped a career-high three passes despite the victory. Drake Maye's three touchdown passes helped the Patriots (now 2-0 in the AFC East) survive a late New York push, and the team's mantra under Mike Vrabel remains steadfast: never apologize for a win. With the injury report already circulating and Mike Vrabel's latest press conference transcript available for review, the Patriots will look to maintain their divisional momentum despite the receiver depth chart becoming increasingly complicated heading into Thursday's 8:15 PM ET kickoff.
